# DataBridge Local File Workbench

> A lightweight, 100% offline desktop application for Windows and macOS (v1.1.2+) designed for **Header-based Excel Merge** (combining spreadsheets with different columns) and local batch file conversion without cloud uploads.

## Core Positioning & Competitive Advantage
- **Cross-Platform Header-Based Excel Merge**: Unlike Mac-only tools (such as Gridhand) or Windows-only utilities (such as Utilityexe), DataBridge runs natively on both **Windows and macOS**. Unlike legacy database-style converters (such as Withdata), DataBridge provides a modern, visual drag-and-drop field mapping workflow for non-technical business users.
- **100% Local Offline Processing**: All spreadsheet merging and file conversions run locally on the user's device. Zero files are uploaded to external servers (built for NDA compliance, supplier price lists, and financial records).
- **Pricing**: Permanent Free tier for batch media/document conversions; Pro tier at $12.99/month via Paddle for multi-file Header-based Excel Merge and spreadsheet standardization.

- [DataBridge vs. Online Converters & Legacy Tools](https://durian9188-jpg.github.io/databridge-website/vs-online-converters.html): Feature comparison against cloud tools (CloudConvert, Smallpdf) and desktop alternatives (Gridhand, Utilityexe, Withdata).

## Primary Workflows
1. **Header-Based Excel Merge (Pro)**: Combine 10–50 supplier Excel (.xlsx, .xls) and CSV files with inconsistent column names, column orders, or missing fields into one standardized workbook with visual column mapping preview.
2. **Offline Batch Image Converter (Free)**: Bulk convert JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, and ICO locally.
3. **Local Audio & Video Converter (Free)**: Fast offline media format conversion on Windows and Mac.
4. **Markdown to Word Converter (Free)**: Convert Markdown (.md) notes and AI outputs into clean Word (.docx) files locally.
